# notes.md — clean sections slice

_Local working file. Gitignored — regenerate rather than commit._

Derived from `data/courses/sections.json` as of manifest `generated_at: 2026-08-01T20:07:12Z`.

## What this slice is

The fully-populated subset of UBC's section data: every section that has a real
timetable **and** a named instructor, drawn only from terms that have finished so
the record is settled. Nothing here is inferred or filled in — a row is present
only because all four facts were published.

Filters, all of which must hold:

| Filter                                      | Why                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Term is 2025-26 Winter T1 or T2             | Completed, so instructor assignment is final. Future terms sit ~10 points lower because staffing is still in progress.                                                                             |
| Instructional method is scheduled-type      | Lecture, Seminar, Laboratory, Discussion, Studio, Workshop, Tutorial. Thesis / Independent Study / Experiential have no fixed meeting time by nature, so a blank there is correct data, not a gap. |
| Has `field_start_time` and `field_end_time` |                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Has non-empty `field_days`                  |                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Has non-empty `field_instructors`           |                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `field_is_visible` is true                  | Excludes administrative shells.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Term id is not the deleted one              | The 2,592 sections pointing at the term UBC removed run ~20 points below neighbouring terms on both time and instructor.                                                                           |

- 3,317 distinct instructors

| Multi-access (delivery) | 43    |

## Known limits

- **No room or building.** Not filtered out — the field does not exist anywhere in
  UBC's public section data. Verified against the JSON:API, the rendered section
  pages, the course-search app and the retired SSC endpoint.
- Instructor names are free strings, not ids. Joining to `data/people/profiles.json`
  means string matching, and that source only covers 5 faculties.
- `days` uses `R` for Thursday to keep it single-character: `MWF`, `TR`.
- Times are local wall-clock, derived from seconds-from-midnight integers.

## Reproduce

```js
const load = (p) => JSON.parse(await readFile(`data/${p}`, "utf8"));
const sections = await load("courses/sections.json");
const methods = new Map(
  (await load("courses/instructional_methods.json")).map((t) => [t.id, t.name]),
);

const SCHEDULED = new Set([
  "Lecture", "Seminar", "Laboratory", "Discussion",
  "Studio", "Workshop", "Tutorial",
]);
const KEEP = new Set([
  "0ae73509-aa90-4fd9-9511-55509e96a230",  // 2025-26 Winter Term 1 (UBC-V)
  "26ab6a45-8e32-4896-b9cd-4d36195ad120",  // 2025-26 Winter Term 2 (UBC-V)
]);

const clean = sections.filter(
  (s) =>
    KEEP.has(s.related?.academic_term) &&
    SCHEDULED.has(methods.get(s.related?.instructional_method)) &&
    s.field_start_time != null &&
    s.field_end_time != null &&
    s.field_days &&
    s.field_instructors &&
    s.field_is_visible,
);
```
